test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**ensuring**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage discusses the goals of the Indian Food Safety and Standards Act of 2006, particularly in terms of consumer protection.
 
• The appropriate verb should convey the idea of making certain that safety and wholesomeness of food are met at all stages.
 
• "**Ensuring**" fits well as it means to make certain or guarantee, aligning perfectly with the context of guaranteeing food safety standards.
 
• Other options ("**entangling**", "**manipulating**", "**contradicting**") do not align with the intended meaning of providing consumer protection.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The food industry in India accounts for about 26 percent of the gross domestic product (GDP) and will be one of the major__ growth areas in the years ahead. This has given *__*impetus*__* to international trade but has also increased the responsibility to achieve the appropriate level of *__*safety*__* in terms of sanitary and phytosanitary protection. Further, the Indian Food Safety and Standards Act of 2006, reflects a major shift in food laws and seeks to provide greater consumer protection by *__*ensuring*__* the safety and wholesomeness of food at all stages of the food chain. This changing scenario has widened the scope and ________5______ career options in this area.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Entangling**: "Entangling" means to involve someone in difficulties or complicated circumstances, and does not fit the context of providing protection.
 
• **Manipulating**: "Manipulating" means to control or influence skillfully or artfully, which does not relate to the idea of guaranteeing food safety.
 
• **Contradicting**: "Contradicting" means to deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite, which is not appropriate in the context of ensuring safety.
